name: The Loop
description: This has happened before. It is happening. It has happened before. The room is a short piece of tape spliced end to end and you are somewhere in the middle of the splice, going round, finding it funnier each time.

objects.name: the splice
looks: The join is right there. You go over it every few seconds.
You have looked at this exactly this many times before.
It is a short loop and getting shorter.

objects.name: the joke
looks: It is funnier on each pass, which cannot go on.
You have got the joke. You had it last time too.
Underneath it there is something ordinary and enormous.

ambient: The loop shortens by a beat.
You arrive at the splice, and go over it, and arrive at the splice.
